mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_standings ( competition, team_code, team_name, team_crest, group_name, position, played, won, drawn, lost, goals_for, goals_against, points, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{competition}, #{teamCode}, #{teamName}, #{teamCrest}, #{groupName}, #{position}, #{played}, #{won}, #{drawn}, #{lost}, #{goalsFor}, #{goalsAgainst}, #{points}, NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (competition, team_code, group_name) DO UPDATE SET team_name = EXCLUDED.team_name, team_crest = EXCLUDED.team_crest, position = EXCLUDED.position, played = EXCLUDED.played, won = EXCLUDED.won, drawn = EXCLUDED.drawn, lost = EXCLUDED.lost, goals_for = EXCLUDED.goals_for, goals_against = EXCLUDED.goals_against, points = EXCLUDED.points, updated_at = NOW()
